responsibility: Implements Rust HIR expression type checking and expression-driven type inference. This is the main visitor for expression forms: it resolves literals, tuples, calls, method calls, control-flow expressions, field and path accesses, borrows and dereferences, matches, casts, operator overloading via lang items and trait calls, and pattern-sensitive constructs; it invokes path probing, method resolution, coercion, unification, and call checking, then stores the resulting TyTy type and receiver/adjustment metadata in TypeCheckContext.
same_name_distinction: Implements the full expression-type-checking visitor, including the bodies for expression-form visit methods, path/method/call resolution, operator-overload handling, unification, and context updates. In contrast, rust-hir-type-check-expr.h only exposes the TypeCheckExpr API and helper declarations.
